description.value: Nemesis Coffee is a specialty coffee roaster and multi-location café group based in Metro Vancouver, with this Surrey 'Pavilion' branch serving espresso and filter coffee sourced from named farms and individual producers. Pastries from their in-house Dope Bakehouse label — including croissants and pain au chocolat — round out the menu. The company roasts its own beans and is a proud supporter of World Coffee Research, signalling a genuine craft-roaster ethos rather than a commodity café.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Nemesis Coffee at 13380 102A Ave Surrey as its active 'Pavilion' location, one of five Metro Vancouver branches; the address matches OSM exactly. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the fetched website content. A discrepancy exists between OSM weekday opening time and the Pavilion hours shown on the website, suggesting the OSM entry may reference a different location's hours.
concerns: OSM weekday opening time differs from what the website lists for the Pavilion (Surrey) location — the OSM hours may be outdated or copied from a different Nemesis branch (e.g. Gastown).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible specialty coffee café confirmed via the business's own website as the Surrey Pavilion location of a legitimate multi-branch chain.
